This is a SOURCES SOUGHT ONLY. Please indicate if your company is willing and capable to perform maintenacne on a wrong way detection sysytem( (WWDS) IAW with attached Draft Performance Work Statment (PWS). All work shall be done in accordance with manufacturer’s specifications and in coordination with the 436 FSS DOVER AFB.

Please email Binod Pathak at binod.pathak.1@us.af.mil and Justin Bordalo at justin.bordalo@us.af.mil,if willing and capable of satisfying this requirement. Include your companies CAGE code and any active GSA contract numbers in all correspondence. Additionally, all Requests for Information (RFIs) via email must be submitted NLT  30 April 2026.
